description: Read the dated census of public MCP and A2A endpoints that Agent Record probes every day: counts by status (working, auth required, gone and others), median latency and how many registry entries cannot be tested. Use it for the big picture of what works today, for example before choosing among many similar tools. day defaults to the latest run. Free, read-only, not counted against lookups.
name: agentrecord_census
title: Read a daily census
